svg.title: Baljinder Singh — apps built and published
svg.desc: Animated neon burgundy project constellation showing Netset POS, Netset POS Admin, Netset POS Staff, In-Transit, UinOne, Union, Union Driver, Kacyber Go, Akbar Academy and OnShip. Original user-provided logo artwork is embedded for Netset POS, In-Transit, UinOne and OnShip; the other square app icons are cropped from the user-provided project showcase reference.
